_doc: Bruno finds the impostor: sentence starters for the clue round (clue) and the discussion (discuss), per level, in European Portuguese (tu between players, enclisis: usa-se, faz-me). The clue starters avoid o/a pronouns and adjective endings where they can (isto, disto, nisto), because they give away the gender of the secret word. The game shows the ones of the level and tops up with the levels below (game.js, redemittelFor).
